packs.name: EPSO Numerical Reasoning — Eurostat Tables

packs.name: EPSO — Official Sample Tests
packs.description: 22 authentic MCQs from EPSO's published sample tests (verbal, numerical, abstract reasoning + language comprehension). Sourced from eu-careers.europa.eu under CC BY 4.0.

packs.name: EPSO Verbal Reasoning — EU Acts

packs.source: EUR-Lex Cellar — passages quoted verbatim, MCQs hand-authored

packs.name: EU Member States — Geography and Facts
packs.description: 25 MCQs covering EU member states: capitals, accession dates, populations, and geography. Supports EPSO Verbal/Numerical context knowledge. Facts paraphrased from Wikipedia (CC BY-SA 3.0).
packs.source: Wikipedia — EU member state articles (CC BY-SA 3.0)

packs.name: GRE High-Frequency Vocabulary — Cloze

packs.source: Wiktionary example sentences (via dictionaryapi.dev) — word selection from public GRE frequency lists

packs.name: GRE High-Frequency Vocabulary — Definition Match
packs.description: "Which word means X?" MCQs over 50 high-frequency GRE words. Definitions from Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 3.0), word selection compiled from public GRE frequency lists.
packs.source: Wiktionary (via dictionaryapi.dev) — word selection from public GRE frequency lists

packs.name: Word Origins
packs.description: 30 MCQs tracing common English words back to their Greek, Latin, Old English, or Arabic roots. Free-tier pack. Etymology data paraphrased from Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 3.0).
